title: Two Study Routines: A New Week, A New Plan · 独立口语迁移
instructions: 先完成示范段的跟读诊断，再用不同人物、信息或立场录制自己的完整回答。示范与自由回答分别取证，服务未提供完整听音评阅时保持待评。
reference: Lin and Maya are classmates in an English class. They are talking about study routines this week. Lin says, 'I usually study in the morning. I get up at six and read for thirty minutes. I always write new words in a small notebook.' Maya says, 'I rarely study in the morning. I often study at night. I usually listen to English songs before bed.' This week is different. Lin is studying at night because she has a morning job. She is drinking tea and reading a story now. Maya is studying in the morning this week. She is sitting at the kitchen table and writing sentences. 'I am not watching TV now,' she says. 'I am doing my homework.' Their teacher, Mr. Chen, asks, 'Do you study every day?' Lin answers, 'Yes, I do. I study for one hour every day.' Maya says, 'No, I don't. I study for two hours on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.
prompt:
Part 1
Do you study in the morning or at night?
What do you usually do before bed?
Do you use a notebook or a phone for new words?
How often do you study English?

Part 2
Describe your study routine. You should say: when you usually study; where you study; what you do first; and how you feel about your routine.

Part 3
Do you think a good routine is important? Why?
Do you often change your study time?
What are you doing this week to improve your English?
Do your friends have the same routine as you?
